create_parametrized_shape: create a ParametrizedShape with r0, z0, kappa, delta, radius, lambda and side parameters for tokamak plasma shape control
generate_random_shape: generate a uniform random ParametrizedShape using uniform_random_shape with configurable bounds for r, z, kappa, delta, radius and lambda
generate_shape_points: generate shape points from a ParametrizedShape using gen_points to produce evenly spaced r,z coordinates with spline interpolation
interpolate_shape_spline: interpolate shape points along a spline using spline_interpolate_points to produce smooth evenly spaced plasma boundary contours
canonicalize_shape: canonicalize a Shape object using canonical to produce a fixed number of points with derived params including kappa, delta and radius
